'''Lamington''' is a dessert of sponge [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]] (or more traditionally, butter cake), cut into squares, coated in a layer of chocolate or strawberry icing, and topped with coconut.

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Sponge Cake|Sponge cake]]
* Chocolate [[Cookbook:Icing|icing]]
* [[Cookbook:Coconut|Dessicated coconut]]

==Procedure==

# Cut the sponge cake into your desired shapes (commonly 5–7 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] cubes).
# Prepare a flat tray with an even layer of desiccated coconut shavings
# Dip the sponge cake cubes into chocolate icing.
# Immediately dip the coated cake into the coconut, or sprinkle the coconut on top.
# Put aside to dry and set.
